login.subtitle: The community's tables, all in one place.
login.disclaimer: It is the only way in: there is no separate sign-up and no password. You need to be a member of the server.
login.serverUnavailable: We could not reach the server. Try again in a moment.

callback.loadingDescription: We are checking that you are a member of the CentralDungeon server on Discord.
callback.notGuildMemberTitle: You are not on the server yet
callback.notGuildMemberDescription: You need to join the community's Discord before you can come in.
callback.blockedDescription: You cannot sign in. Contact an admin if you think this is a mistake.
callback.genericErrorTitle: We could not sign you in
callback.genericErrorDescription: Try again. If it keeps happening, it is our fault and not yours.
